entries.claim: Phase 1's fast-path case is still named (D-04, Task 7) as the "recommends and writes nothing" check, but now runs under D-16's grant with no Write grader. Its graders are only recommends-fast-path and no-ask-user-question. So nothing checks that a new run started with `/seldon <dump>` writes nothing before the user confirms a path.
entries.failure_scenario: Plan 3's run command passes `--allow-tools "Edit(.planning/seldon/**)" ...` to every case, and D-16 records that this grants Write inside .planning/seldon/. In phase 1 the fast-path case had no write tool, so "writes nothing" held because the model couldn't write. Now it can. Suppose SKILL.md regresses so the recommendation turn on a new run also drafts and writes .planning/seldon/brief.md, which FLOW-06 forbids. The fast-path case still scores 1.00, because its last message still has `Recommended path: fast path` and no grader counts Write. The only Write-max-0 recommendation case is asks-for-dump, and it enters through SKILL.md's "Dump given" branch. So the most common entry, a `/seldon` with the dump in $ARGUMENTS (the "New run" branch), has no proof that it writes nothing. The same gap leaves replay's coaching-confirm turn with Write available and ungraded.
